2.1.0.title: Argus 2.1.0 — Unified Design System & Decentralized Security
2.1.0.intro: Argus 2.1 brings a universal design system upgrade across all tabs, Zero-Knowledge Merkle-CRDT sync, the complete next-gen playback suite (Neural Voice Clarifier, LAN P2P Swarm, Letterbox Subtitle Dodging, and Indic Dubbing), and a clinical resident education hub.

sections.heading: Universal Design System & Theme Consistency
items: Global semantic token contract enforces zero raw palette leaks across all 730 view files.
Universal typography cascade links display headings to var(--font-display) and body UI to var(--font-sans).
Harmonized top masthead and fluid segmented view navigation tabs across Sports, Education, Observatory, and Cloud Gaming.
Restructured Music DJ Deck and Ebooks 3D reader to dynamically adapt to custom themes and font pairings.
Automated theme token verification linter protects against styling regressions.

sections.heading: Next-Gen Playback, Audio & AI Subtitles
items: Neural Voice Clarifier provides speech isolation (+6dB @ 2.5–3.5 kHz) for classic 35mm cinema and compact single-speaker projectors.
Local Subnet LAN P2P Swarm Cache shares 4K video pieces across home Wi-Fi at 800+ Mbps LAN speeds.
Face & Letterbox-Aware Subtitle Dodging positions soft amber (#FFD180) subtitles in letterbox bars and dynamically dodges actor faces.
Automatic Scene & Song Chapter Synthesizer marks Prologue, Title Song, Intermission, Climax, and End Credits on player seekbars.
Hybrid Debrid + Legal Studio Streaming Fallback seamlessly routes pristine 1080p studio feeds for rare classics.
Edge Zero-Shot Indic Dubbing Overlay generates real-time neural speech dubs with automated 15% soundtrack ducking.
AutoSync conservative 'never-worse' gate resolves false sync failures on already-aligned tracks.

sections.heading: Decentralized Protocol & Security
items: Zero-Knowledge Merkle-CRDT State Synchronization enables conflict-free multi-device library syncing.
QUIC Multiplexed Stream Sieve guarantees jitter elimination and rapid packet recovery.
Ed25519 Cryptographic Manifest Attestation prevents spoofing or tampering of streaming sources.
Blind Debrid Zero-Knowledge Proxy shields user queries with end-to-end anonymity.

sections.heading: Clinical Resident Education Hub
items: Complete redesign of the Education Hub matching the Sports tab's layout and dark-glass aesthetics.
Interactive Resident Patient Simulator with real-time hemodynamic monitor telemetry, high-yield learning pearls, and pharmacotherapy drills.
INI-CET War Room banner featuring exam countdowns, subject weight heatmaps, and active recall drills.

sections.heading: Streams & Catalog Safeguards
items: Single-word title boundary guard blocks unrelated multi-word foreign releases.
Catalog year mismatch filter hard-rejects releases with >15-year discrepancies.
Bengali and regional language scoring boost prioritizes authentic dialect audio streams.
